name: WE
title: Witness encryption (primitive family over an NP relation)
description: Witness encryption as a Sigaba Neo primitive AdvancedEncryption.WE R p, after Definition 2.1 of Hair-Sahai, arXiv 2609.18275: algorithms Enc(phi, beta) (randomized) and Dec(phi, w, ct) (deterministic), one-bit messages, no setup. Propositions: correctness >= 1 - 2^-kappa for every (phi, w) in the relation and every bit; false-statement security cost/advantage^2 >= 2^lambda for every statement outside the language and every explicit adversary. Cost: time(Enc) + time(Dec) + descLen(Enc) + descLen(Dec). The relation (statements, witnesses, encodings) and the parameters are arguments; a concrete instance with P, R and SubmissionProp is a separate node.
